title: The Seeds They Would Not Eat: Leningrad's Starving Botanists
summary: Tells how, during the siege of Leningrad from nineteen forty-one to nineteen forty-four, the botanists of the Vavilov Institute starved to death among sacks of rice, nuts and potatoes in order to protect the nearly two hundred thousand samples in the world's first seed bank. The episode ranges from the imprisonment of Nikolai Vavilov, who built the collection, in the Lysenko purge and his death from starvation in a Saratov cell, to the watches kept over the display cases through the winter of the siege, and to the fact that after the war not a single sample was found missing.
